overviewHtml:
Threat feeds list indicators of compromise, but security teams still have to check by hand whether any of them touch their systems.

What you get

  • A parent workflow that fetches the threat pulses you subscribe to in AlienVault OTX
  • Each pulse, with its indicators of compromise, passed to a sub-workflow you choose
  • A way to assess exposure by searching your Dynatrace data for those indicators
  • Manual or scheduled runs
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows
  • An AlienVault OTX account and API key
  • otx.alienvault.com in the allowed outbound connections
  • A sub-workflow that analyzes one pulse, for example by searching logs and network data in Grail for its indicators. It isn't included here.
setupHtml:
1. Download alienvault-pulses-analysis.workflow-template.yaml and upload it in Workflows.
  2. In get-alienvault-pulses, add your AlienVault API key, for example as an X-OTX-API-KEY header from the credential vault.
  3. In analyze-alert, select the sub-workflow that processes each pulse.
  4. Run it manually, or add a schedule trigger.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows, an AlienVault OTX API key and a sub-workflow that analyzes one pulse.

  1. Upload the workflow template in Workflows
  2. Add your AlienVault API key
  3. Select the sub-workflow that analyzes each pulse
  4. Run it manually or add a schedule
